recommendations.title: Eliminate Cross-App Direct Imports
recommendations.description: Found 9 direct import(s) between first-party apps across 4 app(s). This violates strict modularity and creates tight coupling that makes independent deployment, testing, and scaling impossible. Breakdown: nexus_core: 2 import(s); nexus_economy: 1 import(s); nexus_social: 4 import(s); nexus_tournaments: 2 import(s).
recommendations.action: Replace direct imports with one of: (a) Django signals for event-driven communication, (b) Celery tasks for async work, (c) REST API calls via nexus_gateway, (d) shared service interfaces in nexus_core.

recommendations.title: Reduce Cyclomatic Complexity
recommendations.description: Average complexity is 2.30 (target: ≤10). Max complexity is 21 in a single function. 20 function(s) exceed the threshold of 10, making them hard to test, understand, and maintain safely.
recommendations.action: Refactor high-complexity functions by: (a) extracting helper methods for distinct logical branches, (b) replacing long if/elif chains with strategy pattern or dispatch dicts, (c) breaking functions >50 lines into smaller composable units. Aim for cyclomatic complexity ≤10 per function.

recommendations.title: Investigate Ghost Files
recommendations.description: 8 file(s) exist on disk but were not discovered by pydeps. Affected apps: nexus_core (3), nexus_social (4), nexus_tournaments (1). These may be dead code, unreachable entry points, or files that need to be added to the project's module tree.
recommendations.action: For each ghost file: (a) check if it is imported anywhere — if not, delete it, (b) if it is needed, ensure it is properly included in the app's __init__.py or referenced in the project's module graph, (c) update physical_inventory.txt after changes.

recommendations.title: Resolve Intra-App Circular Imports
recommendations.description: 5 circular dependency cycle(s) exist within a single app. These cause ImportError at startup if import order changes and hide design problems.
recommendations.action: Move shared constants and type definitions to a dedicated `types.py` or `constants.py` module that nothing in the app imports from. Use lazy imports (inside function bodies) as a last resort.

recommendations.title: Move Shared Utilities to nexus_core
recommendations.description: 1 module(s) are imported by 2 or more apps as violations. This means they are shared utilities living in the wrong app: `nexus_gaming` (used by nexus_social, nexus_tournaments, nexus_core).
recommendations.action: Move these modules to nexus_core (or create a nexus_shared package). Update all imports. The violation count will drop to zero for these once the module lives in the right place.
